previous_scope: Empirical CA1/PFC learning-dependent coding geometry and navigation readout in the original rat panel, with raw versus GLM-expected activity, task-relevant dimensionality, source geometric trajectories, empirical/theoretical readout and behavioral comparisons, and indispensable source controls. Original GLM fitting supports this family; no whole-paper simulations, artificial networks or other biological datasets are added.
selected_scope: Original rat PFC and CA1 500-ms spike-count prediction from navigation covariates, retaining both source regional tenfold Poisson-GLM comparisons across all eight rats and eight learning sessions per rat. Reproduce the author cross-validated deviance-explained results and compare candidate predictions on the identical original data, covariates, folds and regional reductions. Geometry, optimal coding and behavioural readout findings remain separately named reproduction.
source_locator: Nature Neuroscience 10.1038/s41593-025-02183-y, Methods GLM analysis and Figure 7 support; original fit-GLMs-rat.py.
original_data_and_units: Eight rats with eight learning sessions per rat, both PFC and CA1, all original eligible units and movement periods. Exact native NWB-to-session/anatomical/unit mappings and ZT2 identity remain unauthenticated.
original_inputs: Single Day W-Track Learning DANDI 000978 version 0.240511.0307. Inputs x/y position, x/y velocity and inbound/outbound trajectory type; targets original 500-ms spike counts. Preserve Gaussian Nadaraya-Watson interpolation, movement near 4 cm/s, unit-rate threshold near 0.1 Hz, adaptive Gaussian bases and trajectory-specific spatial terms.
original_split: Original per-unit tenfold CV over ten L2 strengths plus shared basis-hyperparameter selection. Recover native row order/folds, source library behavior and relationship between selection and reported scoring. Preserve source full-session covariate standardization and resolve rate >0.1 Hz/boundaries; a new rat/session holdout is a separate task.
metric_and_complete_support: Poisson D²=1−D(y,mu)/D(y,mean(y)), source null/zero-count convention; higher separately for PFC and CA1. Preserve exact fold/unit/session/rat weighting, invalid-fold/null-unit policy and regional rat SD companions. No invented pooled 0.27.
strongest_original_comparator: Original source adaptive-basis Poisson GLM with the complete original regularization and shared basis grid. Compare against stronger of qualified published and matched author rerun regional outcomes; source fitting selection optimism must be disclosed and addressed before superiority admission.
